notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a replication report headed “Replication of a Research Claim from Buchner et al. (2009),” naming Omid Ghasemi and Anna Szabelska, project ID Buchner_EvoHumanBehavior_2009_j2yd_5796, OSF project https://osf.io/su48v, and source URL https://osf.io/hmune/download. These match the assigned replication identifier, named lead team, project and download URL. The report does not reproduce the complete author list or date in the supplied reference, but explicitly presents replication results rather than only a preregistration or abstract. Original article title, authors and journal citation also match the assigned reference; no original primary source was supplied or examined. Target was identified from the report’s explicit focal-analysis statement and claim, not row order or numeric matching. The page-2 focal delta evaluation prints chi-squared = 2.7878, df = 1, p-value = 0.09498 followed by Phi = 0.2103587; Phi is retained without conversion. The earlier G^2 = 6.435107, p = 0.09225716 and G^2 = 1.678981, p = 0.19506 concern separate restricted models and are not substituted for the focal test. The report states that the formal delta evaluation and Phi were added after preregistration. Source is supplied canonical text with page breaks; no PDF supplied. Only replication es_value_r and pval_value_r are assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders.
